points.description: States at least four distinct IPv6 objectives, each matching an item in the model answer. Accepted objectives: supporting billions of end-systems (larger address space); reducing routing table size; simplifying protocol processing with a simplified header; increasing security; supporting real-time traffic and quality of service (flow label, traffic class); providing multicasting; supporting mobility; being open to future change (extension headers); and coexisting with existing protocols. Any wording is accepted.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 for two or three correct, distinct objectives; 0.25 for one correct objective

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming at least four distinct objectives from the model answer, in any wording, such as "bigger address space" for billions of end-systems or "QoS" for real-time traffic. Give half for two or three correct objectives and a quarter for one. Repeats of the same objective count once, and a wrong or irrelevant extra objective does not cost marks unless it contradicts one of the correct ones. No marks if no valid objective is stated.
